mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the rank information coefficient over triggered periods is not statistically significant at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 3% coincident with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8% signals a deepening recession, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate in at least one NBER-defined recession start.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points for three consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered months, or the trigger fires without a subsequent earnings downgrade cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for four consecutive months signals a contraction in economic output, which reduces corporate revenue and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous value * 0.99 for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate during a NBER-defined recession.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) and personal savings rate (implied by RSAFS/GDPC1 ratio) above their respective 12-month moving averages signals improved household balance sheets and confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered months, or the interaction signal does not precede a documented recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% combined with a consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate below 1% for three consecutive months signals an extended period of monetary accommodation and low inflation, which supports risk asset valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% AND CPIAUCSL growth < 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate during a period of explicit central bank forward guidance for zero rates.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) acceleration above 0.5% for two consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered months, or the trigger fires without a subsequent earnings upgrade cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals improving consumer demand, which lifts corporate revenues and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12MMA AND RSAFS > 12MMA in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered months, or the mechanism fails to activate during a documented acceleration in GDP growth.
